description: This file contains utility functions and enums for processing and unwrapping command-line invocation commands, especially handling environment variable assignments, option flags, and nested command wrappers within a larger execution environment context.

classes.name: ExecEnvInvocationUnwrapper
classes.description: Provides static methods to unwrap and resolve nested command invocations in shell command contexts, particularly handling environment variable setting wrappers and nested invocations.

classes.name: UnwrapResult
classes.description: A data structure to hold the result of unwrapping a command, including the cleaned command array and a flag indicating use of modifiers.

methods.name: basenameLower
methods.description: Extracts the basename of a path, lowercases it, and handles normalization of backslashes to forward slashes.

methods.name: isEnvAssignment
methods.description: Checks if a token is an environment variable assignment using a regex pattern.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps nested command invocations, returning the command array with wrappers removed.

methods.name: unwrapWithMetadata
methods.description: Performs unwrapping with additional metadata about whether modifiers are used.

methods.name: unwrapDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Recursively unwraps nested 'env' invocation wrappers, respecting a maximum nesting depth.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentEnvInvocation
methods.description: Unwraps transparent environment invocation tokens, returning the command starting after environment variable assignments if successful.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Recursively unwraps transparent 'env' invocation wrappers, respecting maximum depth.
